The '''Clabburn Tundra''' was a stretch of frozen wasteland on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The area became a battleground between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], and scavenging [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Clabburn Tundra was also the site of [[Gargath's Watch]], a stretch of tundra patrolled by the massive [[Kintan crusher]] [[Gargath]].
